claimsToVerify: Roman doctors used bronze tools like levers and arrow extractors.
Roman doctors used vinegar (acetum) to wash wounds to prevent infection.
Willow bark (containing salicin) and poppy seeds (containing opiates) were used by Romans for pain relief.
Archaeological evidence (healed skulls) shows Romans survived trepanation/brain surgeries.
